rationale: Shifts the limited fp16 export budget deeper into the winning recurrent tail by keeping value matrices for every recurrent block while only preserving q/k on the final tail block. The hypothesis is that reverse-tail recurrence is more sensitive to value-path reconstruction than to older tail q/k precision, so this should improve final int8+zlib roundtrip fidelity without adding parameters or runtime cost.
title: Tail Value-Path FP16 Reallocation
